_meta.what_this_is: Training points sampled from a saturating relationship y = 100*x/(x+50) over the window x in [10, 50], where the curve bends only gently so a straight line fits it well. Plus query points -- two inside the fitted window and two far beyond it -- each with its true y from the same curve, so the extrapolation error is exact and checkable. The point: a line fit on [10, 50] is excellent there and predicts nonsense at x = 200, where the true curve has saturated toward 100 but the line keeps climbing.
_meta.data_is: A FIXTURE. The (x, y) points are the true curve's values (rounded), and the least-squares fit, predictions, residuals, and support check are all computed in extrapolate.py. tolerance is the in-range error bar the fit is expected to stay under; the far queries deliberately exceed it many times over.
_meta.format: train: [[x, y]]; queries: [{x, true_y}]; tolerance: the acceptable in-range error.
